display.purpose: Major agent messages and empty-state prompts.

mono.purpose: ASCII, timestamps, IDs, and tool output.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Rare cobalt action for starting or continuing an agent mission.

components.name: Mission Composer
components.description: Merriweather prompt field with one contained send action.
components.html: Find and remove my personal information.
components.css: .ds-composer{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;background:oklch(0.992 0.003 86);color:oklch(0.22 0.012 264);border:1px solid oklch(0.865 0.01 86);border-radius:10px;padding:14px 14px 14px 18px;font:400 16px/1.5 Merriweather,Georgia,serif;box-shadow:0 12px 36px rgba(24,25,30,.08)}.ds-composer span{flex:1}.ds-composer button{width:36px;height:36px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:oklch(0.48 0.19 264);color:oklch(0.992 0.003 86)}.ds-composer button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid oklch(0.48 0.19 264);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Selected Mission Row
components.description: Open row with a pale cobalt wash and internal selection marker.
components.css: .ds-mission{position:relative;width:100%;padding:14px 16px 14px 22px;border:0;background:oklch(0.94 0.035 264);color:oklch(0.22 0.012 264);text-align:left}.ds-mission:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:10px;bottom:10px;width:2px;background:oklch(0.48 0.19 264)}.ds-mission strong,.ds-mission small{display:block}.ds-mission strong{font:600 13px/1.4 'Avenir Next',sans-serif}.ds-mission small{margin-top:3px;color:oklch(0.52 0.016 264);font:400 12px/1.4 'Avenir Next',sans-serif}.ds-mission:focus-visible{outline:2px solid oklch(0.48 0.19 264);outline-offset:-2px}

components.name: Evidence Row
components.description: A confidence-bearing source row separated by alignment, not a card.
components.css: .ds-evidence{display:flex;align-items:start;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid oklch(0.865 0.01 86);color:oklch(0.22 0.012 264);font:400 12px/1.45 'Avenir Next',sans-serif}.ds-evidence strong,.ds-evidence small{display:block}.ds-evidence small{color:oklch(0.52 0.016 264);margin-top:2px}.ds-evidence span{font-family:SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;color:oklch(0.52 0.016 264)}

narrative.overview: A calm editorial conversation bound to a rigorous evidence desk. ASCII is a state instrument, not decoration.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cobalt occupies less than ten percent of a screen.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Merriweather speaks; sans-serif labels; monospace proves.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Alignment, whitespace, and hairlines precede shadows.

dos: Do open directly on the working agent.
Do keep synthetic and connected data visibly distinct.
donts: Don't use multicolored dashboards or unreadable ASCII noise.
